architecture_pivot.mfl_transport_retry_role: Optional diagnostic only. It cannot restore the old target as primary or change the Option D architecture.
architecture_pivot.new_primary_target: Historical fundamental class talent from player-level H3.O2 outcomes, indexed without fantasy rookie ADP.
architecture_pivot.old_primary_target: Historical H3.O2 values grouped by observed Superflex rookie-draft R1-R4 early/mid/late cells.
architecture_pivot.one_qb_historical_adp_role: Quarantined sensitivity analysis only after the primary model is frozen. It cannot raise confidence, tune features, select models, or construct synthetic historical SF rankings.
architecture_pivot.problem_with_old_target: The H3.O2 values themselves are market-free, but the fantasy rookie-draft ordering that assigns players to cells is a market ordering. That mixes fundamental player outcomes, market ordering, and Superflex format in one target.

interpretation_gates.middle_zone: Research-only/shadow. Do not fit a production class multiplier from six class-level points.

bridge_contract_2018_2023.purpose: Test whether the new fundamental class-talent score remains meaningfully related to the already-exposed SF-cell class score without fitting free class-level loadings.

exposure_and_second_look_disclosure.formal_test_policy: The first extended Option D V0 executed after this B5 freeze is the formal target-level signal test. The six-class B3 result is exploratory and may not be pooled with or used to tune B6.

forbidden: continue forcing old MFL SF ordering into the primary historical target
manufacture historical SF rankings by mathematically adjusting 1QB ADP
hybridize 1QB RB/WR/TE ordering with synthetic QB placement for the primary target
use KTC or other market prices to construct or fit fundamental class talent
use fantasy rookie ADP in the primary Option D historical target
choose UDFA population branch after seeing H3.O2 outcomes
change H3.O2 value-function constants after seeing extended class results
change top-6/7-12/13-24/25-48 primary buckets after seeing results
change formal V0 thresholds after B6
pool the exploratory six-class B3 p-value with the formal Option D p-value
score 2027 before historical target and predictor method are frozen

formal_v0_next_stage.fail_action: STOP Draft Class Strength V1 predictive modeling and retain neutral class factor 1.00.
formal_v0_next_stage.primary_null: Pool eligible player H3.O2 outcomes across included classes; randomly reassign players to class labels while preserving each class's eligible-player count, then sort within each permuted class and recompute top-48 class strength.
formal_v0_next_stage.reliability: max(0, 1 - mean(primary-null class-score variance) / observed class-score variance)

reliability_bootstrap.unit: resample eligible players with replacement within each class, preserving each class's observed player count

formal_v0_next_stage.secondary_position_preserving_null: Permute within position while preserving each class's observed QB/RB/WR/TE counts.

future_sf_translation_contract.application_note: Actual NFL draft capital cannot be used to price a future class before that capital exists.
candidate_inputs: NFL draft capital or point-in-time projected draft capital appropriate to application date
other prospect attributes frozen before the mapping study
future_sf_translation_contract.target: observed SF rookie-draft ordering/slot where trustworthy

replacement_pool_position_lineage_harden.full_nfl_replacement_pool_position: season-appropriate nflverse roster position mapped by stable player ID; do not classify historical replacement pools from a current 2026 Sleeper position snapshot
replacement_pool_position_lineage_harden.reason: V5 audit found current-position lineage could reclassify historical IDP replacement pools.

historical_range_contract.class_exclusion_rule: A class is excluded only for preregistered source/identity/H3-completeness failure, never because its strength result is surprising or hurts significance.

later_pricing_value_stop_rule.action: Do not deploy a class-strength pricing adjustment.
later_pricing_value_stop_rule.trigger: If a validated class model's plausible production multiplier range is approximately within +/-3% of 1.00, or smaller than V10's own relevant pick-value uncertainty/error.

next_stage: B6 Option D historical target construction for 2010-2023.

outcome_sorted_target_contract.class_log_strength: log(class top-48 H3.O2 total / leave-one-class-out mean top-48 total)
outcome_sorted_target_contract.leave_one_class_out_baseline: For each scored class, compute expected top-48 total and bucket means from all other eligible historical classes only.
outcome_sorted_target_contract.nfl_draft_slot_secondary_curve: Allowed as a separately reported diagnostic only.
sensitivity_boundaries_allowed: top60 total if all classes have >=60 eligible H3.O2-ready players
outcome_sorted_target_contract.ties: Break exact H3.O2 ties by stable player ID ascending solely for deterministic ordering.

player_scope_contract.idp_policy: DL/LB/DB class-strength modeling requires a separately preregistered successor; it is not silently mixed into V1.

branch_A.name: DRAFTED_PLUS_UDFA
branch_A.use_if: A reproducible UDFA registry/source can be built for every candidate year before outcome access, with >=95% stable-ID resolution overall, no year below 90%, and no inclusion criterion based on games, fantasy points, career success, or later market value.

branch_B.name: DRAFTED_ONLY_PRIMARY_UDFA_SENSITIVITY
branch_B.use_if: Branch A's source/identity gate fails before outcomes.

predictor_stage_after_v0.anchor_window: September 15 through October 15 of year before NFL Draft

report: QB-only share of class top-48 H3.O2 total
non-QB share of class top-48 H3.O2 total
largest single-player share of class top-48 total
qb_dominance_diagnostics.winsorization: Primary remains the frozen H3.O2 value function. Report a 99th-percentile pooled-player winsorized sensitivity only.
